name: ioctl_fslabel
synopsis: int ioctl(int fd, FS_IOC_GETFSLABEL, char label[FSLABEL_MAX]);
int ioctl(int fd, FS_IOC_SETFSLABEL, char label[FSLABEL_MAX]);
description: These ioctl operations allow getting or setting the filesystem label for the filesystem associated with the file descriptor fd, if the filesystem supports online label manipulation. The FS_IOC_SETFSLABEL operation requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN privilege.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ioctl command, such as FS_IOC_GETFSLABEL or FS_IOC_SETFSLABEL

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Buffer to hold or provide the label string

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: label references an inaccessible memory area
The specified label exceeds the maximum label length for the filesystem
The filesystem does not support online label manipulation
The calling process does not have sufficient permissions to set the label
